fidelity_targets.spec: SigLIP/CLIP-style ViT producing continuous semantic features
fidelity_targets.implemented: Tiny ViT (patch=16, dim=192, depth=6, heads=3) trained with a sigmoid image-text contrastive objective on a synthetic mini-corpus of image-caption pairs derived from procedurally generated shapes and the two real images.
fidelity_targets.deviation: Smaller scale due to CPU-only constraint.

fidelity_targets.implemented: VQ-VAE with 4x downsample CNN encoder/decoder, codebook size 256, embedding dim 64, EMA codebook update.
fidelity_targets.deviation: Smaller codebook + higher rFID than LlamaGen (CPU constraint).

fidelity_targets.spec: Single causal Transformer doing next-token prediction over text tokens AND image VQ tokens AND understanding-encoder embeddings.
fidelity_targets.implemented: Tiny GPT (dim=192, 6 layers, 6 heads, ctx=512). Three modality input adapters: text embedding, VQ-token embedding, understanding-feature projector. Pre-pended <BOI>/<EOI>/<BOG>/<EOG> special tokens flag modality boundaries.
fidelity_targets.matches_named_method: Yes (Chameleon-style early-fusion at sequence level, Janus-style decoupling at the encoder level).

fidelity_targets.spec: Understanding path uses semantic encoder; generation path uses VQ tokens. They DO NOT share the same visual front-end.
fidelity_targets.implemented: Two distinct nn.Modules with no shared parameters; only the Transformer trunk is shared.

fidelity_targets.spec: Compare a Chameleon-style single-tokenizer baseline against the decoupled design.
fidelity_targets.implemented: Baseline reuses the VQ tokenizer's continuous encoder features for the understanding task as well; decoupled uses the dedicated semantic ViT. Compare alignment quality with image-text retrieval accuracy and a shape/colour probe.
